description: Eerste Helmersstraat 241-243 (1901): 5.7 m red-brown brick fronts of four storeys under a cream moulded cornice at 13.2 m; three axes of two-light windows with a transom, segmental heads on storeys 1-2, flat on the ground and the top storey; white sills; one white vent panel per axis in the frieze; a brick wall dormer over the centre axis with a curved stone top

wall-dormer.note: 241, 243: a brick wall dormer on the centre axis, one light, curved stone top

door-right.note: 241: house door on the right axis

door-left.note: 243: house door on the left axis

rhythm.identicalBays: every storey: 3 two-light windows with a transom
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; door left or right
rhythm.roofline: cream cornice at 13.2 m over a frieze with three vent panels; a brick wall dormer on the centre axis

match.note: Eerste Helmersstraat 241-243 (1901), 5.7 m; cornice 13.2 m on the strip
